verdict.rationale: Tavily ships official, documented SDKs. The Python SDK (`pip install tavily-python`, GitHub tavily-ai/tavily-python) has sync and async clients covering search, extract, crawl, map and research. The JavaScript/TypeScript SDK (`@tavily/core`) has its own quick-start and reference docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use, and evidence that the JS SDK covers map/research (its docs cite only search, extract and crawl).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Python SDK allows for easy interaction with the Tavily API, offering the full range of our search functionality directly from your Python programs.
For greater flexibility, we provide both a synchronous and an asynchronous client class.
Use `@tavily/core` to call Tavily Search, Extract, and Crawl from your JavaScript and TypeScript programs.
Tavily's JavaScript SDK allows for easy interaction with the Tavily API
